scope: native CPU/GPU model reload publication transaction
verified: old CPU publication and GPU geometry retained during staging
successful CPU/GPU publication shares catalog publication identity
stale ticket rejects prepared GPU result without changing accepted publication or cache
failed import retains accepted publication, geometry and cache
deferred GPU failure clears pending ticket and retains accepted publication
shutdown cancels unfinished GPU preparation and retains accepted publication
limits: direct transaction fixture; not full watcher/filesystem import lifecycle
